description.narrative: Polar Salud, S.A.P.I. de C.V. (Polar or the Company) is a healthcare group that aims to identify, acquire, and operate private hospitals across Mexico to serve the middle-income and lower-middle income segment.

The most significant, expected project level outcome is increased access to higher quality healthcare for the middle-income population of Mexico. Beyond the project, IFC anticipates that greater consolidation and competition across the mid-level hospital market will result in greater efficiency and quality improvement.
